items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Francois took a likening to me ‗cause he seen something in me, that I didn‘t realize what he saw. But he put me in the high school band

ctx.x: I told you? No I didn‘t! But you hit his name right. Granville, was my older brother, he was a better trumpet player than me. And the school that we went to, well he was older than me, I was like three or four years younger than him. So, anyway, him and Francois—the teacher at Dunbar High School—they didn‘t make it together, they didn‘t relate and my brother quit the school. He like was in like the tenth or eleventh, or whatever grade he was, but he quit school. Francois was, I was like in the seventh or eighth…
